Description: Add "listen to this article" to any page with a single element. By default the reader's browser speaks the text with its own built-in voice and your server synthesizes nothing. For server-made neural voices with real word timings, install the separate BaryoDev.Umbraco.ReadAloud.Azure package and set Provider to Azure with your own Speech resource; the core package reads no credentials. The Edge endpoint option is deprecated, is not a supported Microsoft API and no longer works without a token this package does not generate. If server audio fails, the client falls back to the browser's speech synthesis, so a page always has a voice. Audio is cached on your own server, word highlighting follows real timings from the engine rather than estimates, and nothing about a listener is ever stored. No table, no migration, no IP, no user agent. Free and MIT licensed, with no build step and no third-party dashboard.
